simple.meaning: עָוַן (ʻâvan) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to watch (with jealosy).” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in 1 Samuel, beginning at 1 Samuel 18:9. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עָוַן (H5770) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: עָוַן (ʻâvan) / H5770 is traced through 1 Samuel 18:9 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H5770. avan [ עִין ] verb denominative eye (enviously), look (askance) at; — Qal Participle (or Pô`el מ omitted, see Dr), with accusative עוֺיֵן 1Sam 18:9 Qr (Kt עון ).

occurrences.englishText: Saul watched David from that day and forward.
